bot.name: UAlbertaBot
bot.description: A Terran MarineRush opponent with a fixed opening and no learning between games.

externalRatings.notes: User-supplied saved standings; exact rated build and server measurement date unknown. Not a rating for this pinned source build.

formats.notes: Terran local 1v1 tested on Fighting Spirit with x86 and x64 SC:R; human and observer sessions. See the release review for exact builds and limitations.

mapConstraints: Legacy SC:R unit limits required by the experimental bridge.

learning.notes: Strategy learning is inactive in the pinned source. The packaged fixed configuration disables opponent result storage and opponent-specific overrides; in-game chat cannot change these settings.

localDistribution.evidence: Scoped staging package source/notice and rebuild review: https://github.com/ShieldBattery/robotics-facility/blob/ualbertabot-sb-3/docs/ualbertabot-source-review.md

publicCompetition.evidence: Track separately from local distribution; author outreach planned by Travis.

modifications.summary: Fixed quiet Terran MarineRush configuration disables complete-map information, user input, debug output, result storage, and opponent-specific strategy overrides.
Chat configuration setters are disabled, the process exits after one completed match, and the replaced timer uses an independent std::chrono implementation.
BWAPI selects the match discovery table through SB_BWAPI_INSTANCE and rejects malformed instance identifiers.
The native Win32 recipe statically links the MSVC runtime.

bot.name: OpprimoBot
bot.description: A classic Terran opponent that builds infantry backed by bunkers and siege tanks. Human difficulty is not yet calibrated.

formats.notes: Local Terran combat against ZZZKBot on Fighting Spirit 1.3 with x86 and x64 SC:R. See admission review for exact bridge and package versions.

mapConstraints: Legacy SC:R unit limits required by the experimental bridge.

learning.notes: Fixed fresh-history profile: strategy history, result statistics, profiler output and terrain cache/logs are disabled.

localDistribution.evidence: docs/opprimobot-admission.md: pinned source/dependency review, corresponding-source rebuild, and local x86/x64 combat validation.

publicCompetition.evidence: Track separately from local distribution; author outreach planned by Travis.

modifications.summary: Disabled game speed, user input, debug display, chat controls, and the bot timer; the external client exits after one match.
Disabled strategy history, result and profiler persistence, and replaced the Pathfinder worker with at most one synchronous path calculation per callback.
BWTA2 is source-built for BWAPI 4.4 with terrain cache and log writes disabled.
BWAPI selects the match discovery table through SB_BWAPI_INSTANCE and rejects malformed instance identifiers.
The native Win32 recipe links the static MSVC runtime.
